How it works
Up and running
in one evening
1

Set up your society

Create your society, set your handicap rules and invite members with a link or a short code. Takes about ten minutes.

2

Enter scores on the day

Any player can enter scores hole by hole on their phone. Stableford points and the live leaderboard update as they go.

3

Publish results

Review the leaderboard, confirm handicap changes, assign prizes. One tap to publish — posts straight to WhatsApp.

4

Season runs itself

League points accumulate, handicaps update automatically, and the standings page is always live for members to check.

We built GolfSoc because we were tired of the same problem — someone volunteers to keep a spreadsheet, scores come in over WhatsApp, handicaps get updated whenever anyone remembers. It works, but barely, and it always falls on one person.

GolfSoc handles all of that automatically. We're a small Irish team and this is a new product. We'd rather be honest about that than pretend we've been around for years. We answer emails and we'll actually listen if something doesn't work for your society.

— Shane, GolfSoc  ·  hello@golfsoc.ie
